title: Fed Cuts to Zero and Pledges Open-Ended Bond Buying
note: The Federal Reserve's balance sheet climbs from $4.3 trillion to almost $7.2 trillion in under three months.

title: Beijing Imposes a Security Law on Hong Kong
note: China's top legislature outlaws secession, subversion, terrorism and foreign collusion in Hong Kong, and the law takes effect the same night.

title: Trump Supporters Storm the US Capitol
note: A mob halts Congress's count of Joe Biden's win for hours; Mike Pence declares the result before dawn on 7 January.

title: Taliban Take Kabul as the Afghan Republic Collapses
note: Ashraf Ghani flees, and a US-led airlift flies out more than 123,000 people before the last troops leave on 30 August.

title: The West Freezes Russia's Central Bank Reserves
note: The US, EU, UK and allies lock up about $300 billion of the Bank of Russia's reserves and move to cut major Russian banks from SWIFT.

title: Wagner Marches on Moscow, Then Turns Back
note: Yevgeny Prigozhin's mercenaries take Rostov-on-Don and drive north for a day before a deal brokered by Alexander Lukashenko halts them.

title: Trump Wins a Second, Non-Consecutive Term
note: Donald Trump carries all seven swing states, 312 electoral votes and the popular vote; Kamala Harris concedes at Howard University.

title: Rebels Take Damascus as Bashar al-Assad Flees
note: An offensive led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham reaches the capital in 11 days and ends 54 years of Assad family rule.

title: Trump Declares 'Liberation Day' and Tariffs Nearly Every Country
note: From the Rose Garden, Trump sets a 10% tariff on nearly all imports and higher rates on dozens of countries; the S&P 500 sheds $5 trillion in two days.

title: Israel and the US Bomb Iran's Nuclear Sites in a Twelve-Day War
note: Israel opens a surprise air war on Iran on 13 June 2025; nine days later US bombers hit Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan, and a ceasefire Trump brokers takes hold on 24 June.

title: US Forces Seize Maduro in Caracas and Fly Him to New York
note: Before dawn on 3 January 2026, US aircraft and Delta Force raid Caracas and seize Nicolás Maduro; his deputy keeps the government, and Washington takes charge of the oil money.

title: Lula Wins Runoff; Flávio Seeks Annulment
note: Lula takes 51.79% to 48.21%, the first comeback from a first-round loss since 1988.

title: Machado Returns to Venezuela as Trump Backs Rodríguez
note: The opposition leader returns after nearly a year abroad, with no election date set.

title: Starship Reached Orbit. Next, SpaceX Tries to Catch It
note: After a first orbital flight, SpaceX plans to catch both stages on Flight 15.

title: Houthis Hit Ras Tanura as Their War on Saudi Oil Reaches Both Coasts
note: Riyadh confirms a Houthi missile struck its largest refinery; the group's claimed hits on the East-West pipeline and Yanbu remain unconfirmed.

title: Four Years of Ukraine Peace Talks Circle Back to Abu Dhabi
note: Russia, Ukraine and the US plan a trilateral round in the first half of November, the first since the Iran war froze talks in March.

title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defies a Passport Order and Lands in Miami
note: Brazil's defeated candidate crossed into Argentina and flew via Ecuador to Florida after the State Department granted his family visas. He has not been charged.

title: From Miami, Flávio Bolsonaro Calls Himself Brazil's Leader
note: His letter called him Brazil's "rightful president," then "leader"; his own party and campaign manager say there is no evidence of fraud.

title: Sudan's Army and the RSF Go to War in Khartoum
note: Burhan's army and Hemedti's RSF, partners in the 2021 coup, turn on each other; by October 2026 UNHCR counts some 11.3 million people forced from their homes.
